query: I just shipped the new plugin API in src/plugins/ with 8 public functions and none of them have docstrings or usage examples. Before we release v2.0, can you generate complete documentation for the public interface including parameter descriptions and return types?

The README is completely outdated — it still references the old config format from v1.x, shows deprecated CLI flags, and the install instructions don't mention the new npm scope. Can you update it to reflect the current state of the project?

We're about to ship phase 3 which adds breaking changes to the authentication flow. I need you to document the migration path from the old session-based auth to the new JWT approach, including before/after code samples and a changelog entry.

Can you generate API docs for the REST endpoints in routes/v2/? Each route handler has the logic but no swagger annotations or JSDoc comments. We need OpenAPI-compatible documentation for all 23 endpoints.

I wrote a custom B-tree implementation in pkg/btree/ for our indexing layer. The algorithm is non-trivial with rebalancing and bulk-loading optimizations. Can you add thorough documentation explaining the algorithmic choices, time complexity, and usage patterns?

Our architecture has evolved significantly but the docs in docs/architecture/ still show the monolith design. We moved to microservices 3 months ago. Can you rewrite the architecture documentation to reflect the current service boundaries, communication patterns, and deployment topology?

I notice that about half the exported functions in our Go package have godoc comments and the other half don't. Can you audit pkg/ and add missing documentation to every exported type, function, and method? Follow the existing style.

The new CLI we built has 15 commands but the --help text is auto-generated and terrible. Can you write proper long descriptions, usage examples, and a man page or markdown reference for each command in cmd/?

We're shipping a public SDK and the docs/ folder is empty. I need you to create getting-started guide, API reference from the source code in src/sdk/, a troubleshooting section, and example projects showing common integration patterns.

Before closing this phase, review all the new public interfaces added in the last 5 commits. If any exported function or class is missing a docstring, add one. I don't want to ship undocumented public APIs.
Can you help me refactor the database layer to use the repository pattern? The current code has SQL queries scattered across 20 different service files and I want to centralize data access.
Write unit tests for the authentication middleware. Cover the happy path, expired tokens, missing headers, malformed JWTs, and the role-based access control checks. Use Jest and aim for 90% coverage.
I need to set up a new PostgreSQL database with tables for users, organizations, and permissions. Can you write the schema migration including indexes, constraints, and seed data?
Debug why our Docker container exits with code 137 after running for about 2 hours in production. Check the memory limits, look for leaks in the Node process, and suggest fixes.
Can you read through the codebase and explain to me how the event sourcing system works? I'm new to the team and trying to understand the data flow from API request to eventual consistency.
Help me implement a rate limiter using a sliding window algorithm. It needs to support per-user and per-IP limits with configurable windows stored in Redis. Add it as middleware in our Express app.
Review the git log for the last sprint and write a summary of what was accomplished. I need to present this at standup tomorrow — just bullet points of features shipped and bugs fixed.
Set up Storybook for our React component library. I need stories for all 30 components in src/components/ with controls, actions, and accessibility checks configured.
Can you add inline code comments explaining the bitwise operations in the compression algorithm? I understand the high-level flow but the bit manipulation in compress.c lines 142-230 is opaque.
Optimize our GraphQL resolvers — they're making N+1 database queries. Implement DataLoader for the user, post, and comment resolvers and add query batching.
